responsibility: This file is the DFA pipeline model for the P6600 core, covering scalar integer, MDU, floating-point, and MSA/vector execution resources. It defines the AGQ/ALQ queues, separate multiply and divide units, short and long FPU pipelines, and target-specific reservations for scalar loads/stores/branches/arithmetic, HI/LO and multiply/divide operations, floating-point instructions, and MSA classes, making it the primary scheduler description for r6-era p6600 tuning.
